svg.title: A headache is screened for SNOOP4 red flags to rule out a secondary cause (subarachnoid hemorrhage, bacterial meningitis, giant cell arteritis, brain tumour, idiopathic intracranial hypertension, each with its first test and treatment) while the primary headache is named by its ICHD-3 features (migraine, tension-type, cluster) and treated acutely and preventively
